question: Does the audited local lambda3 pair innovation contain dense signed orientation and a live future quadratic action that are absent from every settled pooled, vector, and rank-16 closure family?

source.base_state: The frozen Q24 low-order state on its own autonomous path; no lambda3 state is fed back.
source.law: DeltaM_l^r = sum_{a+b in {7,9}} omega_ab(k3,K21,k4,K31,K22) G_l,r^{ab}, evaluated on the frozen base Q24 pre-reset state.
source.s0_stack: At each captured layer, double-center each unnormalized standardized plane with H=I-11^T/n and horizontally stack [HZ11H|HZ21H|HZ31H|HZ22H]. No per-plane RMS normalization and no averaging is allowed in rank, energy, or action metrics.
source.host_path_enforcement: The diagnostic runner replaces only _four_pair_edgeworth in the audited lambda3 module. It evaluates all 35 weighted kernels once, returns the association-preserving channel-0:17 sum to _full_relu_reset, and captures channel 17:35 sums plus channel-0:17 base moment sums separately at fixed layers. The high total is never returned or persisted.
source.zero_gain_law: The split-source host must be byte-identical to a separately executed frozen base predict_with_native_tape host.

conditional_deployment_law.state: one fp32 dense signed symmetric dimensionless edge plane E_l in post-activation standardized coordinates
conditional_deployment_law.scale_frame: tau_l=sqrt(diag(base post covariance_l)); sigma_pre_{l+1}=base next preactivation standard deviation; B_l=diag(tau_l) W_{l+1} diag(1/sigma_pre_{l+1})
conditional_deployment_law.transport: P_{l+1}=B_l^T E_l B_l; this unstandardizes prior coordinates, applies raw W congruence, and standardizes next preactivation coordinates
conditional_deployment_law.reset_factor: alpha_l=m_pre_l/sigma_pre_l; G_l=Phi(alpha_l); g_l=(sigma_pre_l/tau_l) elementwise G_l, the deterministic standardized-pre to standardized-post factorized ReLU tangent
conditional_deployment_law.output: native-J mean plus delta_mu; Q24 host state unchanged
conditional_deployment_law.zero_gamma_parity: With E_1=0 and every gamma_l=0, every E_l, P_l, and delta_mu_l is exactly zero. A future implementation must use a literal bypass returning the unmodified native-J output buffer and prove byte identity before training; adding a computed zero is not sufficient.
conditional_deployment_law.forbidden_duplicate: No physical injection of D into Q24 covariance, connected moments, PSD repair, star reset, or carrier.

s0_metrics.rank_formula: p_k=s_k(stack)^2/sum_j s_j(stack)^2; effective_rank=exp(-sum_k p_k log p_k)
s0_metrics.action_formula: sqrt(sum_r ||diag(B_l^T Z_l^r B_l)||_2^2 / sum_r ||Z_l^r||_F^2), with B_l in the pinned scale frame

s0_decision.release_rank_scope: Each independently reviewed S0_RELEASE.json must authorize exactly one singleton role rank.
s0_decision.prerequisite_hash_law: Rank201 release pins a passing rank35 result hash; rank643 release pins passing rank35 and rank201 result hashes. A failed receipt cannot satisfy a later prerequisite.
s0_decision.pass: Rank35 returns only GO_TARGET_BLIND_REPLICATION if every metric and firewall conjunct passes. The identical frozen test must then pass observer-fit ranks 201 and 643 before GO_SOURCE_INFORMATION. Only the replicated pass may support a separately reviewed target-bearing preregistration; no pass authorizes training by itself.
s0_decision.fail: CLOSE_SOURCE_COLLAPSE on any miss. No retry, threshold change, channel selection, layer selection, target access, high-host run, OOF, meter, integration, package, or submission.

rss.diagnostic_materialization_scope: The frozen S0 diagnostic imports the audited module and may materialize one 4*35*1024^2*8=1,174,405,120-byte fp64 kernel tensor. This is below the 4GiB single-array cap. Its process-wide <8GiB pass is diagnostic only and cannot establish the 512MiB deployment increment.
rss.required_implementation: A distinct production reducer must never form 4x35. It evaluates one moment and at most three shell channels at a time: 144MiB shell weights + 24MiB kernel block + 32MiB accumulators + 16MiB fp32 E/P/source/scale + <=64MiB normalization/work + 232MiB fragmentation reserve = 512MiB cap. It requires independent static and literal lifetime audits before integration.

board_economics_not_an_s0_gate.promotion_requirement: The max-fixture conversions are conservative screening ceilings only. Final promotion requires the literal per-network MSE_i and F_i aggregate to strictly beat the live leader.

release.s0_run_requires: S0_RELEASE.json with status RELEASE_S0_SOURCE_ONLY, exact derivation/preregistration/runner hashes, exactly one allowed role rank, and all required prior passing result hashes after independent review
